notes.title: New patch!
notes.content:
Hey guys!
A new patch for the game is out!
Make sure to download the patch as the save games from the old build are not forward compatible.

To update your game if you have the old build you will need to clear you local app save data for costume kingdom

This is done via c://username here/appdata/locallow/strattonstudios

If you do have any issues please just reach out to us via our discord or at josh@strattonstudiosgames.com

and i will do my best to assist you!
